description: Immediate incentives override long-term ecological institutional and social responsibility.
Private actors define future pathways around proprietary systems profit and control.
AI systems scale opaque assumptions and unaccountable future classifications.
Preparedness becomes surveillance border control militarization or rights erosion.
Climate futures name justice but fail on finance adaptation repair and local authority.
Expert systems shape policy without participation transparency or contestability.
Community futures are dismissed as unrealistic threatening or inconvenient.
Public foresight capability remains underfunded and unevenly implemented.
